d:
Is Raja Bhaiya’s party going to form an alliance or reach some kind of understanding with the BJP in UP? Should the attendance of several prominent BJP leaders at Dhirendra Shastri’s Ramkatha in Kunda be seen as a signal? Raja Bhaiya and Amit Shah had met during the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, but things did not work out then; will an agreement be reached this time?
